title: Synthesis and characterisation of a chiral lanthanoid cluster with an unusually exposed cubane core via concomitant deesterification of ethyl acetate

synthesis.procedure: A methanol solution of Hmgp (350 mg, 1.11 mmol) and holmium chloride hydrate (211 mg, 0.56 mmol) was treated with triethylamine (0.6 mL) and stirred for 12 h. The solvent was removed in vacuo and the solid was stirred in toluene for 1 h, filtered, and allowed to evaporate slowly. Pale pink crystals of 1 formed after about 5 weeks. The acetate co-ligand is postulated to form in situ by deesterification of residual ethyl acetate from ligand purification.
synthesis.time: stirred 12 h in methanol; stirred 1 h in toluene; crystals after approximately 5 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by solvent removal, toluene extraction/filtration, and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed in vacuo; residue stirred in toluene for 1 h, filtered, and toluene allowed to slowly evaporate to give pale pink crystals after ~5 weeks

source_locations.location: Appendix A (CCDC 827451 assigned to Ho cluster via external CCDC formula match)
